map.均匀度评分 = min(100, 转速 ÷ 进给速度 × 10)，评分越高越均匀: Uniformity score = min(100, blade speed ÷ feed rate × 10), where a higher score is more uniform; thickness deviation (mm) = (100 − score) × 0.05, expressed as ±. Tuning advice: below 800 rpm it is advised to raise the speed to above 1000 rpm; faster than 12 m/min it is advised to reduce to 8~10 m/min; a score of ≥80 counts as well matched.
map.转速 1200 rpm、进给 10 m/min：评分 = min(100, 12: Speed 1200 rpm, feed 10 m/min: score = min(100, 1200/10×10) = min(100, 1200) = 100, deviation ±0.000 mm (ideal). Speed 900, feed 12: score = 900/12×10 = 750 → capped at 100? By the formula 900/12×10 = 750, take min(100,750) = 100. A low parameter case such as 600 rpm with feed 15: 600/15×10 = 400 → still capped. The score easily saturates, so focus on the recommended bands: speed ≥1000, feed 8~10.
map.评分容易满分，该怎么用？: The score easily hits full marks, how should it be used?
map.评分主要作为“是否落入不良区间”的快速判断；实际厚度精度还受刀片锋利度、皮张含水: The score mainly serves as a quick judgement of whether the parameters fall into an unfavorable band; actual thickness precision is also affected by blade sharpness, hide moisture and tension, so it must be spot checked with a thickness gauge.
map.进给太快为什么不好？: Why is a fast feed bad?
map.进给过快时单位长度内刀刃切削次数减少，易出现波纹与厚度不均；降低进给或提高转速可: With too fast a feed the blade makes fewer cutting passes per unit length, which easily causes rippling and uneven thickness; lowering the feed or raising the speed increases cutting density and improves surface flatness.
map.削匀厚度控制工具根据目标厚度、刀片转速与进给速度，评估削匀工序的均匀度与预期厚度: The Skiving Thickness Control tool evaluates the uniformity and expected thickness deviation of the skiving step from the target thickness, blade speed and feed rate, helping operators adjust cutting parameters so the leather thickness stays consistent.
